Right now, 18 candidates are needed. If you are over 24 and interested, please text “More Info” to 5168711276
Just calling and leaving messages to talk to me about an important matter

I received a package on August 6th.  The name was Martina Rodriguez and the address is 1000 State Street in Calumet City Illinois.  This is the ad of Gateway Warehouse Corporation.  Inside was a lotion named Unicorn Fruit.  I did order this item.  I am calling Gateway tomorrow to inform them.  This person has my address.  Please advise.

It tries to get you to sign up for an email newsletter and it only has just this one cat tower listed and you can buy one for 129 dollars or two for 208. They only use AI generated media for their promotions, pictures of the so called product, and even in the "reviews" it uses ai generated pictures from AI videos they used for tiktok.

Offered a job with Amazon
Call 645-241-3705

This is a fake website made to look identical to the actual website. It collects your payment information and then tells you that it needs you to enter a verification code from your bank to proceed, but the code never arrives.

I received an unsolicited package from this address by USPS Ground Advantage. The item that I received was a "panoramic rearview mirror." I have received several other unsolicited packages in the last few months, but not from this return address.
Ordered a bag from vaulta bags on Facebook I paid with my American Xpress card called and the purchase went through no email explanation

Ordered a product with a return policy. The product was inferior. I asked for label to return. They refused and they offered a 20% coupon off next item purchased and would not accept the item back or a refund. After several emails they gave me a $10.59 credit on my card and i am stuck with an inferior product. They would not honor the return policy stated on the site. Since the purchase i have had attempts made for new credit cards in my name. Not sure if it's this site but suspicious.
It took a long time to get the item and stated if does not fit contact the company first and we need to pay for our own return
Just annoying calls multiple times a day from this and other types like it. Number is always spoofed. Given number was callback number

I purchased a dress from Donna's Dresses but realized within a few minutes that the company seemed like a scam. I emailed the support email address and asked for a cancellation within 20 minutes. The policy only stated that I was able to cancel my order within 4 hours, but they told me it had to be fulfilled. When I received the dress, it was poor quality, unlike the photo online. When I've emailed to request a refund, no one has responded to me.
